title: DARPA IPTO Office-Wide BAA HR001126S0001
summary: The IPTO office-wide solicitation seeks research beyond current programs in artificial intelligence, secure and private information processing, and the understanding and resilience of complex systems. The office's current framing explicitly includes megasystems such as supply chains and power grids.
key_findings: IPTO is looking for revolutionary information-processing research outside existing program lanes.
The office connects AI progress with inherent security, privacy, and system resilience.
Complex supply chains and power grids are treated as analyzable megasystems rather than background context.
why_it_matters: It links frontier computation to the reliability of physical and organizational systems that determine whether new capability can operate at scale.
ftfn_relevance: Supports a cross-domain watch lane for AI applied to infrastructure and supply-chain resilience.
Reinforces FTFN's use of systems and dependencies rather than isolated technology lists.
evidence_limits: A broad agency announcement states areas of interest; it does not identify selected performers or results.
The public opportunity page is less detailed than a complete proposal package and amendments on SAM.gov.
